title: Connor McGovern: Josh Allen got involved to make sure I stayed in Buffalo

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Connor McGovern: Josh Allen got involved to make sure I stayed in Buffalo
sources.description: Connor McGovern said last week that he thought his time with the Bills was "over and done," so it came as a surprise when news broke over the weekend that the center was signing a four-year deal to remain in Buffalo.
